customers_say: Customers find this smart lock to be an excellent upgrade over traditional door locks, featuring a beautiful rose-gold/black finish and all necessary security features. They appreciate its functionality, with one customer noting flawless real-time alerts, and its ease of use with multiple unlocking methods, including fingerprint and password entry. The installation process receives positive feedback, and customers consider it worth the price.
